name: Cicuta
source:
Hemmy is having a rough night. As she stumbles through the streets with nowhere to spend the night, she decides to knock on her former lover's door.

[From [url=https://zeltts.itch.io/cicuta]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
海米度过了一个艰难的夜晚。当她跌跌撞撞地穿过街道，无处过夜时，她决定敲响前情人的门。

[来自[url=https://zeltts.itch.io/cicuta]itch.io[/url]]
